The three RowStore keys, 138 raw rows, 6,216 raw records, two standard engineering goldens, 61 named columns, JSON identities, aggregates, and producer report keys agree.

Exactly one numerical identity invocation accounts for two ABI3 engineering goldens while research is ABI4; full and fast library bytes remain required for terminal verification.
Recorded panel replay checks every retained float32 addition and pinned loaded definition path, without random genetic draws or life dynamics replay.
AF is a clean terminal resource dependency only; its scientific success is not an eligibility gate.
An unset protocol refuses scientific outcomes. Incomplete runtime or raw coverage returns no outcome vectors.
interpretation_limits: A gain in production F can be due to lower costs. Captures and capture income must be reported separately before discussing richer behavior.
This is local accessibility within one existing dark-flash world and two retained genetic neighborhoods, not a dark-versus-dim interaction, repeated-search estimate, or memory-isolating experiment.
No successful hand-built body is required for world eligibility. A null mutant result does not refute the independently measured information payoff.
